name: saidwire-mcp
description: Transcribe local audio files and public audio URLs to text, SRT/VTT subtitles or word timestamps.
long_description: English speech-to-text from Saidwire. Ask Claude to transcribe a recording on your computer or at a public URL. WAV, MP3, FLAC, Ogg/Opus, WebM, M4A/MP4 and AAC up to 100 MB / 60 minutes. $0.30 per audio hour; new keys include 120 free hours, no card: https://saidwire.com/dev

tools.name: transcribe_file
tools.description: Transcribe a local audio file to text, JSON with word timestamps, SRT or VTT.

tools.name: transcribe_url
tools.description: Download a public audio URL and transcribe it.

api_key.title: Saidwire API key
api_key.description: Starts with sk_live_. Free key with 120 hours, no card: https://saidwire.com/dev
